Messages.Author: Neil
Messages.Body:
I had a question about Legion. I couldn't find a distinct answer so I
figured I'd check here:

When a vampire with legion on him declares that he's going to make a
fledgling, does he first play the master:discipline card, replace it, see if
anybody blocks, and if nobody does discard his whole hand?

Or does he just declare that he's going to make a fledgling, see if anybody
blocks, then play his discipline card and discard his whole hand all at
once?

Thanks!

Neil

-------------------
Card Text:

Requires a ready vampire with capacity above 7. +1 stealth action

Put this card on this acting vampire. This non-sterile vampire can put a
Master: Discipline card from your hand or ash heap in play to represent a
fledgling with 1 level of that discipline and discard the rest of your hand
as a +2 stealth action. The fledgling is a 1-capacity, non-unique vampire of
the same clan as this vampire. The fledgling cannot act or block or play
cards if this vampire is not ready.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Neil wrote:
> I had a question about Legion. I couldn't find a distinct answer so I
> figured I'd check here:
>
> When a vampire with legion on him declares that he's going to make a
> fledgling, does he first play the master:discipline card, replace it, see if
> anybody blocks, and if nobody does discard his whole hand?
>
> Or does he just declare that he's going to make a fledgling, see if anybody
> blocks, then play his discipline card and discard his whole hand all at
> once?

The latter. And he declares which Discipline card (and whence it comes)
when he announces the action (like Charming Lobby requires the
announcement of which referendum is to be called).
